overridableConfigKeys.description: Actions offered on each row; give an item `roles` to show it only to those viewer roles.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Row click
overridableConfigKeys.description: Event emitted when a row is clicked; opens the grant for editing. Empty disables the row click.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Viewer's role
overridableConfigKeys.description: The signed-in viewer's role that each action's `roles` is checked against. Bind it explicitly at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`) in an app whose identity carries a role; left empty, only actions with no `roles` show.

events.name: PermissionGrantSaved
events.description: Signals that a permission grant has been persisted (create / update); carries the persisted row's id.

events.name: PermissionGrantSaveFailed
events.description: Indicates a failure to persist a permission grant.
events.synonyms: save error, failed save, persist failure

events.name: PermissionGrantDeleted
events.description: Signals that a permission grant has been deleted.

events.name: PermissionGrantDeleteFailed
events.description: Indicates a failure to delete a permission grant.

events.name: DO_CREATE
events.description: Indicates a request to create a grant row.

events.name: DO_UPDATE
events.description: Indicates a grant row has been modified.

events.name: DO_DELETE
events.description: Indicates a request to delete a grant row.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Who can manage grants?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Roles eligible to create, edit, or delete grants. ENFORCED by the DO_CREATE/DO_UPDATE/DO_DELETE transition guards: a viewer whose @user.role is not listed cannot fire a write, from the form submit or from the bus. Empty = every signed-in viewer may manage grants (ungated). Mounting the page is the opt-in — there is deliberately no separate enable flag (a default-off flag made the whole page's affordances dead on a fresh mount).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: admin roles, permission managers, who edits permissions, grant admins, permission matrix, role permissions, capability matrix, permission grants, access matrix, manage permissions

events.name: GRANT_RESOLVED
events.description: Answers a CHECK_GRANT: the capability flags of the first matching grant row, with found=false (and all flags false) when no row matches. Rename to wire the downstream listener; default-deny on found=false is the consumer's choice.
events.synonyms: grant resolved, permission answer, capabilities returned, access decision data

events.name: GrantCheckLoaded
events.description: Indicates the grant lookup for a CHECK_GRANT has been successfully loaded.

events.name: GrantCheckFailed
events.description: Indicates the grant lookup for a CHECK_GRANT failed.
events.synonyms: lookup error, failed lookup, request failure

events.name: CHECK_GRANT
events.description: Asks which capabilities a role holds in a module; the answer arrives as GRANT_RESOLVED (asynchronous — correlate by the echoed role/module).
events.synonyms: check grant, lookup permission, resolve capabilities, can this role see

overridableConfigKeys.label: Answer permission lookups
overridableConfigKeys.description: Answer CHECK_GRANT lookups with GRANT_RESOLVED from the persisted grant table. Off by default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: enable, turn on, activate, permission lookup, grant query, resolve capabilities
